True from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [c for c in counts if c != bg]
    barrier = max(colors, key=lambda c: counts[c])
    barrier_cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == barrier]
    horizontal = len({r for r,c in barrier_cells}) == 1
    obj_color = next(c for c in colors if c != barrier)
    obj = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == obj_color]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in obj:
        out[r][c] = bg
    if horizontal:
        br = barrier_cells[0][0]
        near = min(r for r,c in obj)
        shift = (br + 1 - near) if near > br else (br - 1 - max(r for r,c in obj))
        moved = [(r+shift,c) for r,c in obj]
        for r,c in moved:
            out[r][c] = obj_color
        shadow = max(r for r,c in moved)+1 if near > br else min(r for r,c in moved)-1
        if 0 <= shadow < h:
            out[shadow] = [8]*w
    else:
        bc = barrier_cells[0][1]
        near = min(c for r,c in obj)
        shift = (bc + 1 - near) if near > bc else (bc - 1 - max(c for r,c in obj))
        moved = [(r,c+shift) for r,c in obj]
        for r,c in moved:
            out[r][c] = obj_color
        shadow = max(c for r,c in moved)+1 if near > bc else min(c for r,c in moved)-1
        if 0 <= shadow < w:
            for r in range(h): out[r][shadow] = 8
    return out
